propositions: Operator-attested evidence lacks provenance fields (environment, principal, privilege_posture, instrument) that record where and under what conditions a measurement was taken, preventing detection of measurements that cannot have observed the failure they claim to rule out.

Gates cannot audit world-grounded measurements after-the-fact and should not attempt to re-run them; instead, measurement context must be forced into the record as text so repo-grounded machinery can find contradictions between claims and IaC.

A deterministic (non-LLM) check enforces presence of measurement provenance on [operator-attested] criteria, modeled on det_operator_attested.py, with an advisory LLM criterion to judge declared provenance against repo facts.

Measurements under broader privilege than production (e.g., bedrock:* vs production-scoped IAM) or via instruments that cannot fail for the reason that matters (e.g., simulator vs live call) structurally generate unverifiable success with zero information content.

Plans asserting unchanged behavior across configuration swaps while citing no consumer of that configuration are invisible to review because gates read what plans point at, and uncited paths are the defect's camouflage.
